description.text: 1.Starting Date: September 1 to 5, 2011 2.Application Deadline: July 15th, 2011 3.Notes: Those who miss the application deadline can submit your application materials before September 1st, 2011 at the latest.

duration.text: The Preparation Science of Chinese Medicin at China Pharmaceutical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5000 USD/per year ￥ 36000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1.Applicants for Doctoral program should have a Master's degree or equivalent academic background; 2.Healthy and under the age of 45.
